title: Ragtime and jazz arrive; no recordings; dance halls
summary: Allen asks when jazz came, Labat says after World War I; none of them recorded; they recall dance halls.

story.theme_name: Playing for dancers: dance bands and the dances themselves
story.community_name: Dancing to the band: quadrilles, waltzes and dance sets
